description: beads-sigma-y9rd.7 regression: a NATIVE data-blend workbook (<datasource-relationships>) whose PRIMARY datasource also carries chart-context calcs (RUNNING_SUM + percent-of-total via TOTAL()). The blend path used to early-return before the single-DS calc/pattern processor, so param-switch/window/LOD/percent-of-total patterns were silently lost (0 workbookPatterns). The fix re-runs the single-DS path on a blend-stripped copy and merges the recovered patterns. Reuses CSA.TJ.BLEND_SALES + CSA.TJ.BLEND_TARGETS (same tables as the data_blend fixture).
